title: Looks nice
text: Looks nice. This looks nice and I like the stand that comes with it but I don't like how hard it is to get the ice pop out.  Holds less than 4 oz if you fill to the top but if you do that when you put the top on some spills out to make room for the top.  I tried to make pudding pop but it was very hard to get them to push up.
